# ScanPay

ScanPay is an autonomous code security scanner and execution gate with x402 Solana micropayments for AI agents.

- Production URL: https://scanpay-ob3w.onrender.com
- Remote MCP SSE: https://scanpay-ob3w.onrender.com/sse
- Remote MCP HTTP: https://scanpay-ob3w.onrender.com/mcp
- Payment: Solana mainnet x402 micropayments, 0.0007 SOL (~$0.10) per scan
- Prepaid Session Voucher: 0.006 SOL for 10 instant scans (POST /api/v1/session/deposit)
- Merchant Wallet: JDKXvegmW5j4sAJPB6YCA9ffJbN422WLMmCWCcpy1vm4
- Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, TSX
- Capabilities: Deterministic AST analysis, 45+ vulnerability patterns, automatic patch generation, unified diffs, execution gating (PASS, WARN, BLOCK).
- npm: scanpay-cli@1.0.0, scanpay-mcp-server@0.3.1
- GitHub: https://github.com/Misterio070/scanpay
